title_en: Apartment for sale 3+1+2 toilets+closed garage in Fresk
description_en: Apartment for sale 3+1+2 toilets + closed garage in Fresk. The apartment is located on the 6th and last floor of a well-maintained building with an elevator near DN Market, has a total area of 134 m², very good organization, 2 corridors, balcony, 1 toilet with window, aspiration system in each room, isolated terrace for private use and sold furnished as in the photo together and with a closed garage 24 m² below the building on the -1st floor with elevator.
